verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed, built-in automations: per-invoice booleans that send payment reminders or a thank-you email, and smart categorisation that learns from previous descriptions. These are adjacent preset toggles rather than a capability for users to define their own event-triggered rules, and there is no documented rule builder or custom trigger-action configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
